items.item: Warns about the formula compiled-size limit (15,000 bytes) and that referencing other formulas counts their compiled size
items.evidence: "The limit is 15,000 bytes compiled... A formula's compiled size includes the compiled size of every formula it references. Fifteen formula inputs... are likely to exceed the limit."

items.item: Offers an alternative if the limit is hit (e.g., before-save flow or Apex that stores the value)
items.evidence: "Fallback if it doesn't compile: make Health_Score__c a stored Number field set by a before-save record-triggered flow on Account."
